name: Ticking Steps
description: An overlay with a list of steps that tick off one by one, the current one held in the centre, while something slow happens.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, in order. Done steps get a water-filled check, the current one a spinner, the rest an empty ring.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the overlay. Each time it opens it starts again from the first step.

props.name: loop
props.description: Start again from the first step after the last one is done, until loading is turned off.

props.name: contained
props.description: Cover the nearest positioned parent instead of the viewport. The parent needs position: relative.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blurs the page behind the scrim. Off by default: the browser redraws the blur on every frame while anything behind it changes, which stalls on large pages, most of all in Firefox.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when the last step is done. The overlay stays until loading is set to false.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button in the top right corner, also bound to Escape. Focus moves to it when the overlay opens and returns when it closes.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the overlay. Other div props, such as aria-label (default "Progress"), are passed through.
